narrative.northStar: The Architectural Engineering Monograph — Moss Ink & CLI Centerpiece Edition
narrative.overview: This design system rejects generic cyber-neon clichés in favor of an editorial engineering monograph anchored by an interactive CLI Terminal right in the Hero and a refined, non-neon deep green palette.
keyCharacteristics: Deep moss ink (#0B100E) in dark mode and archival sage paper (#F3F5F0) in light mode.
Single high-contrast architectural emerald/forest green accent (#2FBF8A dark / #14724F light).
Interactive CLI Terminal (baxtoos@dev:~) as the Hero centerpiece with '/' shortcut, Tab autocomplete, and clickable command chips.
Exposed 1px structural hairline rules and ledger rows instead of nested cards.

rules.name: The Single Signal Rule
rules.body: Architectural Emerald (#2FBF8A / #14724F) is the only chromatic accent on the page; never combine it with secondary neon hues or multi-stop gradients.

rules.name: The Unassisted Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings (h1, h2, h3) never carry an eyebrow or kicker label above them; the heading's scale and wording carry the hierarchy directly.

rules.name: The Single Elevation Declaration Rule
rules.body: Page containers and project cards declare their boundary with a 1px border and never combine it with a diffuse drop shadow.

dos: Do keep the Interactive CLI Terminal (baxtoos@dev:~) immediately accessible in the Hero with '/' shortcut and one-click command chips.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1 for prose and metadata) in both dark and light themes.
Do disable decorative GSAP/boot motion when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.
donts: Don't place eyebrows or kickers above h1, h2, or h3 headings.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), neon Matrix glows, or heavy 3D canvases that compete with content.
Don't nest cards inside cards or use generic icon-plus-heading boxes for the About or Skills sections.
